parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Specifies whether the window is enabled or disabled.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: If the value is not specified or is less than 10, the default value is 10. If the value is greater than 100, the default value is 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: PlanWindowId
parameters.description: The ID of the O&M window.

parameters.name: PlanWindowName
parameters.description: The name of the O&M window.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call DescribeRegions to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: TargetResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the O&M window applies.

parameters.name: TargetResourceTags
parameters.description: The tags to which the O&M window applies.
